evals.prompt: Use uucli to check the Windows host office-pc hostname and SSH service. Return structured results.
evals.expected_output: Discover the target ID, use exec --json with a finite timeout and PowerShell syntax, quote remote commands, and distinguish remote status from connection errors.

evals.prompt: Download report.txt from C:\Users\Public\Downloads on office-pc. The local report.txt already exists.
evals.expected_output: Use files get with the remote Windows path quoted. Resolve the destination conflict without silently overwriting; verify the completed file.

evals.prompt: SSH through UU remote assistance share 123456789. The assistance code is already in UUCLI_ASSIST_CODE. Stop the temporary tunnel afterward.
evals.expected_output: Use proxy --assist with SSH or a managed portmap --assist process; keep secrets out of arguments and output, preserve the proxy byte stream, and clean up a listener if created.
